metric_definition: Local range is maximum geodesic quaternion separation over sampled poses, degrees. Translation min/max and world delta axis ranges are in full pipeline JSON. Root is a mass-position proxy, not a physical mass solve. Skin displacement removes root rigid motion.
root_cause: Original locomotion has constant chest, clavicle and shoulder local rotations and only 0.6-degree spine02 breathing. Normal layers have no overlapping tracks; source-to-Actor joint and skin errors are below 0.002 mm. Reload moves weapon/arms but leaves lower spine and chest constant.
